title: ward-architecture.toml
description: General architecture rules of the ward gate: a selector, one constraint and a reason, the same in every language. The keys are the ones ArchitectureFileReader reads; ArchitectureSchemaTest keeps them equal.

version.description: The version of the file format.

selector.description: Selects files by project-relative path. A file is selected when it matches an entry of each of paths and directories that is set, and no entry of exclude-paths.

paths.description: Globs on the project-relative path: *, **, ? and {a,b}.

directories.description: Plain directory names; a file is selected when a directory of its path has one of these names (Swift paths compare ignoring case).

exclude-paths.description: Globs of the paths that are left out. This is the only way to leave test sources out.

rule.description: One rule: a name, a selector, exactly one constraint and a reason.

name.description: A name that is unique in the file and starts every finding.

select.description: The files the rule is about.

must-not-depend-on.description: Reports every dependency edge from a selected file to a file of this selector (ward:architecture/dependencies).

may-only-depend-on.description: Reports every dependency edge from a selected file to a project file that is neither selected nor in this selector (ward:architecture/dependencies).

only-accessed-by.description: Reports every dependency edge into a selected file from a file that is neither selected nor in this selector (ward:architecture/dependencies).

file-name.description: A glob on the base name; reports every selected file whose name does not match (ward:architecture/naming).

must-be-in.description: Reports every selected file that this selector does not select (ward:architecture/location).

because.description: The reason, shown at the end of every finding.

allow-empty.description: Lets a rule that selects no file pass instead of failing the gate.
